title: Dr. Glodek Invited to Speak at ILSSAMT
html:
At the invitation of the ILSSAMT Board, Dr Aleksandra (Ola) Glodek of Libertyville, spoke at the Illinois State Society of American Medical Technologists Spring Continuing Education Meeting at Rush University on April 25, 2026. Her presentation highlighted the importance of oral health to systemic health and healthy aging, emerging diagnostic approaches such as saliva testing, and advances in oral microbiome science relevant to medical technologists. A lively discussion reflected attendees’ interest in lifelong oral health and the importance of interdisciplinary collaboration in translating new developments into integrated patient care. Dr. Glodek was grateful for the opportunity to share a topic central to her research interests and clinical practice.

Dr. Ola Glodek, Alicia Taylor, ILSSAMT Vice-President, and Shaista Sayed, ILSSAMT President
